content:
[Verse 1]
[F]Deck the hall with
boughs of holly,
Fa, la, la, la, la, la,
[C]la, la, [F]la!
'Tis the season
to be jolly,
Fa, la, la, la, la, la,
[C]la, la, [F]la!
[C]Fill the meadcup,
[F]drain the barrel,
Fa, la, la, [Dm]la, la, la,
[G]la, la, [C]la!
[F]Troul the ancient
Christmas carol,
[Bb]Fa, la, la, la, [F]la, la,
[C]la, la,
[F]la!

[Verse 2]
[F]See the flowing
bowl before us,
Fa, la, la, la, la, la,
[C]la, la, [F]la!
Strike the harp and
join the chorus.
Fa, la, la, la, la, la,
[C]la, la, [F]la!
[C]Follow me in
[F]merry measure,
Fa, la, la, [Dm]la, la, la,
[G]la, la. [C]la!
[F]While I sing of
beauty's treasure,
[Bb]Fa, la, la, la, [F]la, la,
[C]la, la,
[F]la!

[Verse 3]
[F]Fast away the
old year passes,
Fa, la, la, la, la, la,
[C]la, la, [F]la!
Hail the new, ye
lads and lasses!
Fa, la, la, la, la, la,
[C]la, la, [F]la!
[C]Laughing, quaffing
[F]all together,
Fa, la, la, [Dm]la, la, la,
[G]la, la, [C]la!
[F]Heedless of the
wind and weather,
[Bb]Fa, la, la, la, [F]la, la,
[C]la, la,
[F]la!
title: Deck The Halls
tuning: E A D G B E
